title: resolve-step-model input contract

boundModels.description: The canonical model profile slugs the host can run — the host binding's model map, supplied by the adapter, never authored by an agent. Function 4 ranks only catalogue profiles in this set; a slug the catalogue does not declare is ignored.

description: Input contract for the resolve-step-model harness function: the shared input envelope plus the host's bound models — the step is deduced from the session, never named by the caller.
